findings.title: NEW: Reuters Reports Hacker is Actively Trying to ‘Breach US Federal Election Commission’
findings.summary_md: Mediaite relayed the Reuters report that a hacker was actively attempting to breach the website of the US Federal Election Commission on Tuesday, one week before the midterm elections. The report described the agency taking its electronic filing system offline in response to the activity.

findings.title: Hacking attempts against U.S. election system triggers outage
findings.summary_md: Reuters reported that the US Federal Election Commission's website was targeted by a hacker or hackers, disrupting the agency's electronic filings system a week before the November 3 elections, with the system down since around 10 p.m. ET on Monday. The FEC said its electronic filing system was offline while IT staff worked to restore service, users could still search past reports, and the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency and the FBI did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
